item.title: Nipplegate: The Infamous Nipple Slip Causing Religious Right's Meltdown
item.description: Was it a slip or a planned nip? During the halftime show in Super Bowl XXXVIII, an apparent wardrobe malfunction led to the infamous nipple slip between Janet Jackson and Justin Timberlake. I remember seeing religious wingnuts on Scarborough Country on MSNBC back in 2004, breathlessly claiming their children were severely damaging and traumatized after what they witnessed that Super Bowl Sunday. The religious right nuts from these groups continue to be empowered by network executives. Lisa Bonet
